eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Maricopa, AZ; at 2:18 PM on AUG 11, 2023 Effective until 12:18 AM AUG 12, 2023. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Silver Alert has been issued for Phoenix Police Department.  This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety.  Phoenix Police Department is looking for Kao Chien Chang A 72 year old male, 5' 4" tall, 140 pounds, with black and grey hair and brown eyes. He was last seen in the area of 99th Avenue & Lower Buckeye Road. Kao left on foot. Please contact the Phoenix Police Department with any information. If you have contact with the Silver Alert, Please call 9 1 1.  Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
